name: Goal Line$
blurb: weekly NFL spread predictions from a proprietary model
backstory: torturing easy-to-get historical game data until it gives up its secrets and makes the NFL feel a little less random is a dirty little pleasure of mine. two years in, up $50 on a $100 stake.

name: Product Recommender
blurb: because old people are picky and yet won't read reviews
backstory: My parents sent their robot vacuum back five times before finding the right one.

name: Water's Edge
backstory: so future-us remembers why we chose the tile.

name: Weather Ahead!
blurb: a no-ads, 7-day forecast that shows up in your inbox
backstory: enter your zip code and pick a frequency — you get one plain email with a 7-day outlook and simple icons for good running days, plant-watering days, and freeze warnings. no app, no ads, no doomscrolling a radar map.

name: Finish Lines
blurb: my own run log — targets, progress, and the metrics that actually matter to me
backstory: I use a commercial app for the guided runs themselves, but this is where I actually keep score: goals, progress against plan, longest run, rolling 7-day pace. the calendar of which days I ran is oddly satisfying — sometimes I open it just to look at it.
